nodes.label: Discord Invite Background Artwork
nodes.description: 1920x1080 (16:9) abstract brand background for Discord invites. No text or logo: a diagonal navy gradient (#20294A -> #101426 -> #080C19) with a faint 96px grid, a large indigo (#5B72F2) radial glow at upper right, a lime (#D8F36A) glow at lower left, three layered flowing bezier accent curves (indigo, lime, white) and a few small lime/indigo dots. Purpose: decorative backdrop behind invite content, leaving clear space for overlaid UI.
